book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, not from any translation

sentences.ar: رجل بيزور بيت مطلقة وبيحب يتجوزها.
sentences.en: A man used to visit a divorced woman’s house, hoping to marry her.

sentences.ar: ابنها الزغير كان يحبه ويلعب معه.
sentences.en: Her small son loved him and played with him.

sentences.ar: بيوم، الولد قال له: بدي أحكي لك سر.
sentences.en: One day, the boy said to him: I want to tell you a secret.

sentences.ar: قال الرجل: احكي، وبحلف ما بقول لحدا.
sentences.en: The man said: speak, and I swear I will tell nobody.

sentences.ar: الولد قال: بنشوف بابا كل أسبوع بالسر.
sentences.en: The boy said: we see father every week in secret.
And he cries and asks us about mother.

sentences.ar: بالمسا، الرجل حكى كل إشي لأمه.
sentences.en: In the evening, the man told his mother everything.

sentences.ar: صار في صراخ بالبيت والولد انضرب.
sentences.en: There was shouting in the house and the boy was beaten.

sentences.ar: الولد وقف بالزاوية وهو ما بيفهم.
sentences.en: The boy stood in the corner not understanding.

sentences.ar: كانت أول مرة يعرف إن الكبار بيكذبوا.
sentences.en: It was the first time he knew that grown-ups lie.
